messages:
alex: Morning — quick pulse from release train A (cut in ~3h). What I did: validated canary configs for model-serving lanes, landed kube RBAC fix. Blockers: flaky e2e in linux-rt that keeps failing on image pull; need a hand with registry creds. Today: monitor canary and start cherry-pick window at +90m.

maya: Thanks Alex. Saw the RBAC PR, lgtm on infra side. For image pulls, registry reported a 401 intermittently; jun, did you change any token rotation?

jun: Not intentionally. I updated the rotation TTL last week but didn’t touch the token perms. Checking logs now.

sam: Quick update from QA: two small regressions from yesterday's canary — one is a timing out healthcheck on the tokenizer service (10s threshold), other is a rare mismatch on embedding dims in staging. Both flaky, not consistent.

lina: For the tokenizer timeout, try bumping readinessProbe to 15s in the canary pod spec temporarily, that reduced noise before. We should add a separate eval for alignment of embedding dims ASAP.

deploy-bot: Canary report: lane-model-v2 -> 3/3 healthy, avg latency 42ms, error rate 0.23%. Autoscaler: stable.

alex: Good to know deploy-bot. Maya — can you queue the cherry-picks? I'll own rollbacks if anything spikes. Who can take the registry creds check?

maya: I can. Pinging infra rotation owners @jun. Will DM the immediate creds to debug, won't post secrets here.

jun: Found duplicated credential update yesterday evening in rotation job logs, likely caused brief 401s. I'll revert the TTL change and re-run rotation. Expecting fix in ~20m.

sam: Re: code review pings — PR #4821 (canary tuning) needs a second review; queued tests are green but waiting on nits. Anyone free to approve?

lina: I can take that in 10m. Also small flag: if we increase readinessProbe we should note it in the rollback playbook so ops knows to revert on full rollout.

alex: Good call. Add a one-liner in the PR description and update runbook.

maya: Cherry-pick window open in 90m, current queue: patch for kv-cache serialization, logging header change, and PR #4821 if approved. Prioritize kv-cache and PR #4821.

jun: Rotation rolled back, re-run succeeded. No more 401s in the last 5 attempts.

deploy-bot: CI check: release-train-A branch -> all checks passed (unit+integration). Canary promotion candidate: lane-model-v2 -> eligible.

sam: I'll re-run the flaky e2e with the updated creds and tokenizer probe; will report back in ~12m.

lina: If tests still flake, we should gate the model promotion behind the embedding-dim eval (quick offline script). I can write it in ~30m.

alex: Plan: (1) maya watches cherry-picks, (2) jun confirms registry stable (done), (3) lina wires quick embedding eval if sam sees flakes, (4) I’ll hold rollback channel and monitor telemetry. If all green at +2h, proceed with full rollout.

sam: Running tests now...

sam: Test update — tokenizer timeout gone after probe bump. Embedding-dim mismatch reproduced once, investigation ongoing.

lina: On it, starting the eval script now.

alex: Thanks team. One ask — when cherry-picks land, drop a short note here: file, PR, and who merged. Keeps handoffs clean. :thumbsup:

maya: Will do.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window at +6h for infra upgrades. Not blocking train A but heads up.

alex: Noted.

sam: FYI I’ll be offline for 45m starting in 40m for an onboarding call.

jun: All clear on creds. Marking rotation as stabilized.

lina: Embedding eval script done and pushed to staging; running quick sweep.

sam: Final: embedding mismatch only triggered on one test vector, looks like an old serialized checkpoint sneaking into test data. Cleaning dataset and re-running.

alex: Excellent. We'll keep the train moving if no further spikes. Thanks all, check back in on next pulse or post merges here.
